sentences.text: Vishal Mishra vs State Of U.P. on 12 September, 2024

Author: Saurabh Srivastava
Bench: Saurabh Srivastava
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:151469
Court No. - 83
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8322 of 2024
Applicant :- Vishal Mishra
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Prashant Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.
In Ref :- (Crl. Misc. Modification Application No. 1 of 2024)
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is an application seeking modification of the order dated 1.3.2024 passed by this Court granting bail to the applicant.

2. Heard Sri Prashant Kumar Singh, learned counsel for applicant and learned AGA for the State.
3.

Through the instant application, learned counsel for applicant prayed that a direction may be issued to learned Special Judge, Gangsters Act, Kanpur Nagar to accept the same personal bond and two sureties, which has already furnished by applicant in Case Crime No. 76 of 2023 under Sections 411, 413, 414, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C. wherein in he was granted bail by this Court vide order dated Vishal Mishra vs State Of U.P. on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28753548/
1 16.11.2023.

entities.text: Vishal Mishra vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is submitted that in the present case bearing Case Crime No. 233 of 2023, under Section 3 (1) of U. P. Gangsters and Anti Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986, the applicant has already been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 1.3.2024 but learned court concerned is not accepting the bail bonds and sureties which has already been furnished by the applicant in Case Crime No. 76 of 2023 under Sections 411, 413, 414, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C. and as such, the instant application may be allowed.
4.

entities.text: U. P. Gangsters and Anti Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
In support of his submission learned counsel for applicant relied upon the judgment rendered by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vicky v. State of U.P.
[S.L.P. (Crl.) Nos. 8914-8915 of 2018, decided on 29.10.2018] wherein it has been held that personal bond so executed by accused and bond so executed by two sureties shall hold good for all 31 cases since it will be the misuse of procedure and difficult for the petitioner to arrange two sureties in each and every case.

entities.text:
Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vicky v. State of U.P.
[S.L.P. (Crl.) Nos. 8914-8915 of 2018
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The present applicant has criminal history of 10 cases and it is impossible for him to arrange different sureties in each case.

5. Considering the arguments raised by learned counsel for applicant and in light of the judgment rendered by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vicky (Supra), learned court of Special Judge, Gangsters Act, Kanpur Nagar is hereby directed to accept the same personal bonds and two sureties which the applicant has already furnished in Case Crime No. 76 of 2023 under Sections 411, 413, 414, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., wherein release order has already been passed on 4.5.2024.
6.

entities.text: Special Judge, Gangsters Act, Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In view of the above, the modification application stands allowed 7.
This order shall form part and parcel of the order dated 1.3.2024.

Order Date :- 12.9.2024 Md Faisal  Vishal Mishra vs State Of U.P. on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28753548/
